message:
1 classes name their template file by an expression, not a string:
      libs/components/widget/src/widget.ts: PctWidget
$reason: `templateUrl` naming its file through a constant. ngc evaluates the expression and compiles `widget.html` (measured through ngc in partial mode), while the scanner opens the file named as written, and nothing is. Point 1 says so; without that, `widget.html` stood as a template no decorator names, and a template another class also named would have been read for that class alone.
